annotations.title: EU Green Claims & Anti-Greenwashing Substantiation Auditor

description:
[Deterministic EU anti-greenwashing audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates environmental claims against Directive (EU) 2024/825, auditing carbon-neutral claims for illegal offset-based compensation bans, checking generic claims against EU Ecolabel criteria, and validating PEF/LCA substantiation.
Usage: Use this tool before publishing marketing claims, packaging copy, or sustainability reports in the European Union.
Returns: JSON object with { isClaimLegallyPermissible: boolean, complianceStatus: string, riskLevel: string, detectedProhibitions: array, infringementCodes: array, remediationGuidance: array }.

claimText.description: Full environmental claim text (e.g. "100% Carbon Neutral thanks to reforestation credits")

claimedPercentage.description: Specific numerical percentage claimed (e.g. 40 for 40% recycled)

hasPublicVerificationDossier.description: Whether a public summary dossier is accessible via QR code / URL

substantiationMethod.description: Methodology used to substantiate the claim

thirdPartyCertified.description: Whether verified by an accredited independent body

name: green_claims_substantiation_audit
